# Delivery & Isolation Checklist: PCDF (Programmatic Content Delivery Framework)

**Purpose**: Validate that PCDF requirements (winner selection, date-only schedule, Author-only preview, and PCDF-only hand-off) are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all targeting dimensions that authors can set also defined as optional request dimensions (and vice versa)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK002 Are allowed promotion `status` values besides `ACTIVE` named in the spec, or is “not ACTIVE” the only documented ineligible class? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK003 Is uniqueness of `promotionId` (per locale vs globally) stated as a requirement, or only implied by the tie-break rule? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 Are match-response fields specified when optional content (body, image, CTA) is empty? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK005 Is the hand-off unit specified as one shareable package whose parts (nodes vs dedicated code bundle) must remain distinct? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “highest priority” defined as a comparable numeric order (higher number wins vs other scales)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is lexicographic comparison of `promotionId` specified (case, encoding) enough to pick a unique winner? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK008 Is “today’s calendar date” for live eligibility tied to a named clock (which instance, whose calendar)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK009 Is date-only `startDate`/`endDate` (no time) stated as POC scope, and is inclusive range (`on or before` / `on or after`) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Is “explicit no-match” distinguished from an invalid request (missing locale, preview on Publish)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-027]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do Author-only preview rules agree across User Story 4, FR-013, FR-021, and FR-027 (Publish must not honor preview)? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK012 Did the later date-only clarification fully replace zoned date-time wording so no leftover “instant/timezone” acceptance remains? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK013 Is empty targeting list (match-all) consistent with omitted request parameters (unconstrained) without contradicting “must be present in the list”? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK014 Is “one Content Fragment = one promotion, no variations” consistent with locale-by-folder (not variant sets)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK015 Is PCDF isolation (`core.pcdf`, not default `core`, not `/apps/aem-poc`) consistent across identity, FR-025/026, and User Story 3? [Consistency, Spec §Identity and placement, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-026]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Can SC-002 (sample match vs no-match in one demo pass) be judged without reading internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 Can SC-003 (Author preview of a future window vs Publish live) be judged with the sample `pcdf-future` dates? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §User Story 4]
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-005’s “under 100 milliseconds” scoped to the sample set and local demo, not a production SLA? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK019 Can SC-007 (install PCDF package only) be judged by presence/absence of default site apps and default `core`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are primary flows specified: author without developers, single winner, no-match, Author preview, package hand-off, reuse without page wiring? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–5]
- [x] CHK021 Are exception flows specified for missing locale and for preview supplied on Publish? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements for an unknown locale folder (folder does not exist) specified, or is that intentionally the same as no-match? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK023 Are recovery/rollback requirements for a failed package install intentionally out of scope for this POC? [Coverage, Spec §Out of Scope, Spec §User Story 3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are inclusive date boundaries specified when evaluation date equals `startDate` or `endDate`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are same-priority ties fully specified, including two fragments with identical `promotionId`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 Is `tag` matching specified as exact inclusion only when `tag` is present on the request? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK027 Is `promo` on the request mapped only to URL-parameter targeting (not to `promotionId`)? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-003]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK028 Is anonymous Publish read vs authenticated Author use specified without implying production hardening? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK029 Are CDN/edge cache keys documented as non-goals for implementation while still allowed as an external recommendation? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 Is automated testing explicitly not an acceptance gate, with visible demo + docs as the success evidence? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §SC-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK031 Is the assumption that evaluation uses the demo instance’s calendar date documented and acceptable given timezone is out of POC scope? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK032 Are local Author/Publish ports and sample-credential conventions documented as demo-only? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK033 Does FR-024 (future dimensions without changing existing request/result fields) conflict with adding new targeting later only via model/rules? [Assumption, Spec §FR-024]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK034 Does the spec conflict with the plan on unknown locale (no-match vs invalid) in a way that would change acceptance? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017, Plan/data-model locale folder]
- [x] CHK035 Is “Publish is the public delivery surface” compatible with Author still exposing the same capability for preview when signed in? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK036 Are unpublished fragments on Author in or out of preview eligibility, or is that left to repository ACLs without a written rule? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, Spec §User Story 4]

## Notes

- Reviewer evaluation 2026-08-22: all items passed against the post-analyze spec (unknown locale = no-match, published-only preview, `promotionId` unique per locale, `ACTIVE`/`INACTIVE`, date-only, `ui.config.pcdf`, Java 21 / AEM 6.5 LTS SP2).
